help.stdout:
usage: gnd exp validate [-h] directory

Read <DIR>/SPEC.md and report its structure: id, kind, title, the declared
question ids in declared order, and any follows: references. The spec is
UNTRUSTED committed metadata, so the read is byte-capped before it happens,
anchors/aliases are refused, unknown keys are rejected (extra=forbid), the
experiment kind is a closed vocabulary, and duplicate or empty question ids
are refused — a duplicate declaration makes the close gate's declared-vs-
resolved set difference ambiguous. Exits 0 when the experiment is well-formed,
3 when SPEC.md is unparseable, schema-invalid, or declares an id that
disagrees with its own directory name, 64 on usage errors, 66 when SPEC.md is
missing entirely (fail closed — a directory without a spec is not an
experiment with nothing wrong).

positional arguments:
  directory   the experiment directory

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
